A Conditional Use Permit shall be for a one (1) year period subject to renewal. Such mobile homes shall not be used as rental units, and shall be located on the site in accordance with yard requirements as specified by the Board of Zoning Appeals for residential uses in "A" Agricultural Districts. Mobile homes, when moved into place, shall be at least four hundred (400) square feet in floor area, and be placed on concrete supports and be properly anchored.
